name: DOT diagrams
description: Technical fixture for Graphviz DOT diagrams (diagram syntax "dot"): a release pipeline with a cluster and a decision, an undirected service graph beside text, an architecture with a database cylinder and labeled edges, a state graph on a dark variant, and a graph with an alt. OPF reads the DOT itself and pele lays it out in layers.

slides.title: Every change passes the same pipeline

bullets: Web, mobile and partners call the same API
Search reads from the catalog the API writes

diagram.source:
graph services {
  API [shape=box]
  Web -- API
  Mobile -- API
  Partners -- API
  API -- Catalog -- Search
  API -- Billing
}

slides.title: Decks are validated before they are stored

diagram.source:
digraph architecture {
  rankdir=LR
  node [shape=box]
  Client [shape=ellipse]
  Gateway -> Auth [label="token"]
  Client -> Gateway [label="POST /decks"]
  Gateway -> Validator
  Validator -> Store [label="valid"]
  Validator -> Client [label="findings", style=dashed]
  Store [shape=cylinder, label="Deck store"]
}

slides.title: A deck moves from draft to published

diagram.source:
digraph states {
  rankdir=LR
  node [shape=circle]
  Draft -> Review [label="submit"]
  Review -> Draft [label="changes"]
  Review -> Published [label="approve"]
  Published [shape=doublecircle]
}

slides.title: Rejected briefs return to their author

diagram.source:
digraph review {
  rankdir=LR
  Brief [shape=box]
  Approved [shape=diamond, label="Approved?"]
  Brief -> Approved
  Approved -> Build [label="yes"]
  Approved -> Brief [label="no"]
}
diagram.alt: A brief goes to review. Approved work is built; rejected work returns to the brief.
